cwloadout-desc: Adds loadout functionality to CreateWiki, allowing wikis to be created with pre-populated content from XML dumps and additional extensions/settings.
cwloadout-help-loadout: Select your preferred loadout. A loadout determines the content, templates, extensions and settings your wiki starts with.
cwloadout-help-loadout-none: The wiki is created with only a main page. Ideal if you want to start from scratch.
